name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: The member of the Yearbook club's grade is at least 10% more than Carver.
The Biology class' grade is at most 5% away from Hale.
Bungalow goes with exactly one of English, Chess, or Scouts.
Hale's grade is immediately below the class in the Annex.
The member of the Choir club's grade is between the Biology class and Boyd.
The English class' grade is at least 10% more than Frost.
Carver's grade is between the class in the Pavilion and the Chemistry class.
The class in the Bungalow's grade is exactly 10% more than the member of the Chess club.
